description: Compute whether a set of web features clears an explicit browserslist target query. Every call evaluates the whole query: each feature gets a verdict, the count of failing targets, and its own evaluated and unevaluated target counts with the share of tracked traffic each covers. The target rows behind those numbers — which release each target maps to, which targets were not evaluated and why, and the failing and unevaluated targets of each feature — cover at most ten query targets per call; page through them with target_offset and target_limit, and the verdicts, coverage, and totals stay identical on every page. A target counts as evaluated only where compatibility data was read for it, so a feature clears only when every target in the query was evaluated and supports it, and is inconclusive otherwise — a query that includes a browser with no compatibility data, as "defaults" does, never clears.

features.description: Up to 20 entries, each a browser-compat-data key such as css.selectors.has or a web-features id such as has, 1 to 200 characters. An empty or longer entry is rejected against this schema; a whitespace-only entry returns invalid_feature_input. Call browsercompat_search_features first for any entry whose key you do not already know.

resolve.description: When true, an entry that is neither a key nor an id falls back to the search index, such as "Container queries (size)" or "Element.prototype.animate". Its best exact matches are accepted only when they name one feature: a single key resolves to that key and gets a verdict, several keys of one web-features feature resolve to the feature as verdict ambiguous with compat_keys, and matches spanning two features are a miss. Off by default so a typo returns a miss you can correct rather than a confident answer about the wrong feature.

target_limit.description: How many query targets this page covers, 1 to 10. It bounds every list of target rows in the response and never the evaluation: verdicts, coverage, and totals always describe the whole query.

target_offset.description: Zero-based position in the target list of the query at which this page of target rows starts. Pass the nextOffset of the previous response to continue. An offset at or past the number of targets returns the whole-query verdicts and totals with no target rows.

targets.description: A browserslist query, for example "defaults" or "> 0.5%, last 2 versions", 1 to 500 characters. Required: with no query browserslist would read config from the process working directory rather than from your project.

name: browsercompat_compare_support

all_clear.description: True only when every feature clears, which requires every target in the query to have been evaluated for it.

attribution.description: Required attribution for the caniuse-derived coverage figures in this response.

comparable_features.description: How many entries in features were compared against the targets. A miss or an ambiguous entry is not comparable; at 0 nothing was evaluated.

data_version.description: Vintage of each bundled dataset behind this answer.

bcd_generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the browser-compat-data snapshot was generated at.

browserslist.description: Version of the bundled browserslist query resolver.

caniuse_lite.description: Version of the bundled caniuse-lite snapshot.

web_features.description: Version of the bundled web-features snapshot.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_target_query`: browserslist rejected the targets query. `no_targets_resolved`: The query matched no browser versions at all, or only agents with no browser-compat-data counterpart. A mapped agent whose version token does not resolve is reported in unchecked_targets instead. `invalid_feature_input`: An entry in features is whitespace-only. An empty or over-200-character entry is rejected against the input schema instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evaluated_targets_total.description: Query targets evaluated for every compared feature, across every page. evaluated_targets_total plus unchecked_targets_total is the number of targets in the query.

nextOffset.description: The target_offset of the next page. Present only while targets remain past this page.

offsetNotice.description: Why this page carries no target rows, and the offsets that do.

query_echo.description: The targets query as the server parsed it.

results.description: Per-feature verdicts and totals over the whole query, each with its own target rows for this page.

items.description: One result per input entry, in input order.

compat_keys.description: Present on an ambiguous verdict — the browser-compat-data keys the feature owns. Re-run with one of them.

evaluated_coverage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic the targets evaluated for this feature cover.

evaluated_total.description: Query targets this feature has compatibility data for, across the whole query.

failing_targets.description: The failing targets among the query targets on this page, with the verdict that caused each. Empty on a page that holds none even when failing_total is above zero.

items.description: A target this feature does not clear.

agent.description: browserslist agent id the target came from.

bcd_browser.description: browser-compat-data browser the agent maps to.

bcd_version.description: browser-compat-data release the token mapped to, or null when it predates them all.

verdict.description: Why this target failed: partial means the implementation does not meet the mandatory specified behavior, prefixed means it only ships under a vendor prefix or a different name, flagged means it only works behind a preference or runtime flag, removed means it shipped and was later removed before this target version, unsupported means it was never added, preview_only means it only works in a preview channel.

version_token.description: Version token browserslist produced for that agent.

failing_total.description: Failing targets across the whole query. Present when the feature was compared, as are the five fields after it.

found.description: True when the feature string resolved to a tracked entry.

guidance.description: What to do next on a miss or an ambiguous verdict.

input.description: The feature string as the caller sent it.

name.description: web-features display name for the feature.

baseline_id.description: The web-features id this resolved to, or null when no web-features entry covers the key.

bcd_key.description: The single browser-compat-data key this resolved to, or null when the web-features id spans more than one key.

input.description: The feature string as the caller sent it, trimmed.

resolved_via.description: Which step of the resolution order matched: bcd_key or web_features_id for an exact match, web_features_id_normalized when it matched only after lowercasing, redirect when the input pointed to a browser-compat-data entry that has moved or split, or search when resolve was true and the best exact matches in the search index all named one feature or key — treat a search match as a best guess, not a confirmed key.

resolved_as.description: How the feature string was matched, or null on a miss.

unchecked_coverage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic the targets not evaluated for this feature cover.

unchecked_targets.description: The targets not evaluated for this feature among the query targets on this page, each with its reason.

items.description: A target this feature was not evaluated against.

reason.description: no_bcd_browser when the agent has no browser-compat-data counterpart, unknown_version when the token maps to no release, no_bcd_data when a compared feature records nothing for that browser, no_comparable_feature when every entry in features was a miss or ambiguous so nothing was compared.

usage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic this target covers.

version_token.description: Version token browserslist produced for that agent.

unchecked_total.description: Query targets not evaluated for this feature, across the whole query. evaluated_total plus unchecked_total is the number of targets in the query.

verdict.description: Judged over the whole query, never over one page. fails when any evaluated target does not support the feature; inconclusive when nothing failed but at least one target in the query was not evaluated for this feature, including when none was; clears only when every target in the query was evaluated and supports it; miss when the entry did not resolve; ambiguous when the id spans more than one compat key or owns none.

shown.description: Number of query targets this page covers.

target_coverage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic covered by the targets evaluated for every compared feature; 0 when no feature was comparable.

targets_resolved.description: The mapping inventory for the query targets on this page: each target that maps onto a browser-compat-data release, and whether it was evaluated. A target with no mapping appears only in unchecked_targets.

items.description: A target that mapped onto a concrete release.

bcd_browser.description: browser-compat-data browser the agent maps to.

bcd_release_index.description: Release ordinal used for comparison; -1 when the token predates every release.

bcd_version.description: browser-compat-data release the token mapped to, or null when it predates them all.

evaluated.description: True when every compared feature has compatibility data for this target. False when at least one compared feature records nothing for its browser, or when no feature in the call was comparable — the target then also appears in unchecked_targets. Mapping onto a release is not evaluation.

version_token.description: Version token browserslist produced for that agent.

targets_resolved_total.description: Query targets that map onto a browser-compat-data release, across every page.

totalCount.description: Number of targets the query resolved to, across every page.

truncated.description: True when more query targets remain past this page.

uncheckedNotice.description: How many of the query targets were not evaluated for every compared feature, the agents they belong to, and their combined usage share.

unchecked_coverage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic covered by the targets counted in unchecked_targets_total.

unchecked_targets.description: The query targets on this page that were not evaluated for every compared feature, each with the reason.

items.description: A target that was not evaluated.

reason.description: no_bcd_browser when the agent has no browser-compat-data counterpart, unknown_version when the token maps to no release, no_bcd_data when a compared feature records nothing for that browser, no_comparable_feature when every entry in features was a miss or ambiguous so nothing was compared.

usage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic this target covers.

version_token.description: Version token browserslist produced for that agent.

unchecked_targets_total.description: Query targets not evaluated for every compared feature, across every page.
